profil.title: Profile {profil} ({nr} of {anzahl})
profil.description:
Each profile has three independent day schedules – Monday to Friday, Saturday, Sunday – each with up to three heating periods. Within an enabled heating period the target temperature applies, otherwise the setback temperature. {art}

If the end is before the start, the heating period runs past midnight.

lernen_auswahl.title: IR commands – choose per command
lernen_auswahl.description:
Room **{raum}** · IR transmitter `{sender}` · device name `{geraet}`

{stand}

These commands belong to this room and this transmitter only. For each command:
- **not ticked** = use the existing command (nothing is sent and nothing is learned)
- **“learn again”** = learn the command via this transmitter with `remote.learn_command` and test it afterwards
- **“test”** = send the existing command once with `remote.send_command`

Many air conditioners send their **complete state** (mode, temperature, fan) with every key press. In that case, set up the remote control so that the last key press produces exactly the desired state.

data.testen: Send existing command as a test
data.ueberschreiben: Existing commands may be replaced by learning

data_description.ueberschreiben: Without this tick, no existing command is changed.

lernen.title: Learn command {nr} of {anzahl}
lernen.description:
**{befehl}** – {bedeutung}

1. Prepare the remote control (one step before the desired state).
2. Choose “Learn now” below and click **Submit**.
3. As soon as the lamp on IR transmitter `{sender}` lights up: point the remote control at the transmitter and press the key (within 30 seconds).

The Home Assistant action `remote.learn_command` is used.

klima_schalter.title: Air conditioner on a switchable smart plug – {raum}
klima_schalter.description: The plug only switches the air conditioner on and off; temperature and fan are set by the unit itself. Automatic mode: on when the room is warmer than the target temperature plus the switch-on offset, off when it is cooler than the target minus the switch-off offset (example: target 22 °C, +0.5 / −0.0 → on above 22.5 °C, off below 22.0 °C). “Manuell” on the card = continuous operation. Everything can be changed later in the automation “Klima {raum}”.

steckdose.title: Air conditioner smart plug – {raum}
steckdose.description:
Switchable smart plug with power metering in front of the air conditioner. It stays **switched on permanently**: before every IR command it is switched on if necessary (followed by a short start-up delay), and switched on again 1 minute after being switched off by mistake – it is never switched off. With power metering, the control checks whether the air conditioner executed a command: otherwise it repeats once, then shows a persistent notification.

It is entered in {automationen}. **Leave the plug empty = remove.** Check times and “keep switched on permanently” are then found in these automations in the section “Stromversorgung und Rückmeldung” (power supply and feedback).

geraet.title: {raum} – replace a device
geraet.description: Which device should be replaced? Listed are all devices used by this room's automations and its Better Thermostat (radiator thermostats, sensors, window contacts, smart plug, Broadlink …).

geraet_neu.title: New device
geraet_neu.description: Replaces **{alt}** everywhere in this room (used in: {verwendet}) – in the automations and, if it is entered there, in Better Thermostat (sensors and radiator thermostats; calibration and settings are kept). A radiator thermostat of a different device integration (e.g. Zigbee instead of Homematic IP) is better replaced in Better Thermostat itself – you will be told if that is the case. If the Better Thermostat itself is replaced, the new one gets the same window sensor.{andere}
